description: Corrections to what AWS's Service Authorization Reference says these operations are authorized as, where a live call disagrees (scripts/iam.ts). Each `reason` is the evidence.

value.reason: Granting fsx:CreateSnapshot on its snapshot and volume ARN formats is denied live (Alchemy's FSx Bindings suite: AccessDeniedException instead of SnapshotVolumeNotFound); the call is authorized only on *.

Narrowed to AWS's ARN formats (arn:${Partition}:fsx:${Region}:${Account}:snapshot/*/*, arn:${Partition}:fsx:${Region}:${Account}:volume/*/*), the call was denied live in the FSx Bindings suite; the grant stays on *.
